observations: G13 and G14 are deterministic database reads: neither group needs the Python AI service on :8000, so every case in this run is a real measurement and nothing was skipped.

Defaults confirmed live against the running build: /dashboard/overview caps its active panel at leadLimit 8 (1..50), /dashboard/leads and /dashboard/activity default to 20 (1..100), /audit-logs defaults to page 1 limit 50 (limit up to 200).
Dashboard scope always comes from the access token: ?organizationId= is ignored in both directions, and an authenticated VIEWER sees the same tenant-wide revenue aggregates as an ADMIN.
Audit immutability rests on the absence of write routes only: audit_logs has no user triggers, no revoke-safe constraints and no FAILED producer.

results.title: Bootstrap: three tenants, roles, an eleven-lead pipeline with costed proposals
notes: org A 8728531b-f763-4fc8-b81b-e6d78e6ca131, org B 7b9923de-72ad-4ff9-a7b2-1bf12659fedf, org C f2c4bb00-3e38-4578-a314-f5834a446ffb
pipeline: NEW=2, IN_REVIEW=2, QUALIFYING=1, QUALIFIED=3, PROPOSAL_DRAFTING=1, REJECTED=1, WON=1
proposals priced: USD:12500/DRAFT, VND:250000000/DRAFT, USD:5000/IN_REVIEW, EUR:3000/APPROVED, USD:999999/REJECTED, USD:null/DRAFT

results.title: GET /dashboard/overview KPIs match the fixture pipeline exactly
notes: kpis total 11 / active 9 / qualified 4 / proposals 4
estimatedValueByCurrency [{"currency":"EUR","amount":3000},{"currency":"USD","amount":17500},{"currency":"VND","amount":250000000}] (the REJECTED proposal and the null-cost proposal are excluded)

results.title: Pipeline stages: all nine statuses in order, per-stage lead counts and currency values
notes: stages: NEW=2, IN_REVIEW=2, QUALIFYING=1, QUALIFIED=3, PROPOSAL_DRAFTING=1, APPROVED=0, REJECTED=1, WON=1, LOST=0
SQL GROUP BY status confirms {"REJECTED":1,"QUALIFIED":3,"WON":1,"QUALIFYING":1,"PROPOSAL_DRAFTING":1,"NEW":2,"IN_REVIEW":2}

results.title: Overview activeLeads panel: leadLimit caps the panel, ordering, joined client name, no RFP text
notes: panel capped at 8 of 9 active leads, 1 joined to a client

results.title: Overview leadLimit contract: 1 and 50 accepted, out-of-range, non-integer and empty value handled
notes: every other invalid leadLimit is a 400; only the empty value means "not provided", matching the shared pagination() helper

results.title: GET /dashboard/leads contract: default limit 20, ordering, projected columns
notes: meta.total reports the returned row count (9), not the tenant-wide total — a widget cannot tell that more rows exist behind the limit

results.title: Dashboard limit guards: 100 accepted, 0 / 101 / 200 / negative / non-integer rejected
notes: a non-integer limit is rejected before the query runs, so no SQL sees NaN

results.title: GET /dashboard/activity contract: synthesized feed, four event types, ids and ordering
notes: feed 20 rows, types ["LEAD_CREATED","LEAD_UPDATED","PROPOSAL_CREATED","PROPOSAL_UPDATED"]

results.title: Activity source is entity timestamps, not audit_logs: the feed collapses all history into two rows per entity
notes: L4: 4 audit events, feed gained its only :updated row on this edit (the fixture chain finished inside one second of creation)
the feed equals the SQL over leads/proposals created_at and updated_at row for row (25 ids) while audit_logs holds 45 events for the same tenant, so the two feeds cannot reconcile
actions with no entity timestamp delta (sheet writes, portal sessions, pricing apply, deletes) never appear on the dashboard activity feed

results.title: Empty tenant: a fresh organization gets zeroed KPIs, nine empty stages and empty panels
notes: no NULL/NaN/undefined reaches the client for an organization with no data

results.title: Tenant isolation and scope override: a query organizationId can never move the dashboard into another tenant
notes: org B sees 1 lead / 1 activity rows; ?organizationId is ignored in both directions

results.title: Dashboard access: anonymous 401, every authenticated role can read (no role guard on the dashboard)
notes: dashboardRoutes.ts applies requireAuth + requireOrganization only: a VIEWER reads the full revenue pipeline. Acceptable for a read-only aggregate, but it is the same guard gap already recorded for the vault.

results.title: GET /audit-logs contract: envelope, meta, newest-first order, actor name resolved
notes: total 45 rows, first "LEAD_UPDATED" lead actor "E2E G13 Admin A"

results.title: Audit RBAC: ADMIN and PRESALE_LEAD read, every other role gets 403 naming the allowed roles
notes: the role is taken from the access token, so a body or query field cannot widen it

results.title: Filters: action, entityType, entityId, actorId and combinations match the fixture write counts
notes: counts confirmed against the fixture ledger: {"USER_REGISTERED":1,"USER_CREATED":4,"CLIENT_CREATED":1,"LEAD_CREATED":11,"LEAD_STATUS_CHANGED":23,"LEAD_UPDATED":1,"PROPOSAL_STATUS_CHANGED":4,"RATE_CARD_CREATED":0}

results.title: resultStatus: SUCCESS returns everything, FAILED always returns zero because nothing writes a FAILED audit
notes: AUDIT_RESULT_STATUSES defines SUCCESS and FAILED, and no code path ever records FAILED: a security dashboard filtered on FAILED is permanently empty, including credential-stuffing attempts

results.title: Time window filters: from/to accept ISO-8601, normalize it, and reject anything unparsable
notes: from > to is accepted and simply matches nothing; there is no cross-field validation
isoTimestamp() only asks Date.parse, so "2020" and "0" pass the ISO-8601 claim and are silently normalized to Jan 2020 / Jan 2000 rather than rejected

results.title: Pagination: default 50, limit up to 200, page offsets, disjoint pages, real total
notes: meta.total 45 equals the SQL count for organization A, pages are OFFSET based and disjoint

results.title: Query guards: malformed UUIDs, repeated keys, oversized filters and unknown parameters
notes: sort order is fixed server-side: no sort parameter can reorder or widen the response

results.title: Payload integrity: no credentials serialized, ip_address stored but never returned
notes: stored columns confirmed in PostgreSQL (ip_address present, payload keys ["title","source","clientId"]) while the API row carries none

results.title: Audit completeness: status transitions are recorded, but proposal create / sheet write / delete are silent
notes: actions covered: user, client, rate card, lead (create/update/status/qualify/delete), proposal status changes, pricing apply, portal sessions
actions NOT covered: proposal create / metadata edit / sheet write / delete, meeting and discovery writes, knowledge and RAG usage — the ledger cannot answer "who wrote this section"

results.title: Immutability: no write route exists for audit logs, and reading never mutates the ledger
notes: audit_logs has 0 user trigger(s); immutability is enforced by the absence of write routes, not by the database

results.title: Cross-tenant audit isolation: organization B cannot read or filter organization A history
notes: org B sees exactly its own 2 rows (registration + tenant lead), org A history unreachable

results.title: Teardown: fixture counts reconciled with SQL, audit trail left intact for the cleanup script
notes: SQL ledger: leads 11, proposals 6, audit rows A=47 B=2 C=1
audit rows are intentionally kept: cleanup SQL removes them with the test organizations

regression evidence for the fixed stage count: replaying the pre-fix GROUP BY status,currency query over this tenant would report QUALIFIED: 1 instead of 3 — G13-02 now asserts the true per-status counts
